description: Unit tests for a parser and tokenizer in a C++ project, specifically testing parsing of expressions, functions, conditionals, comments, and error cases in a codebase related to the 'gn' build system.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes input file content into tokens, returning success status.
